Smoke test: PNG image (without OCR, metadata only)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/images/sample.png")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"disable_ocr\":true}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)

asyncio.run(main())
```
